The scars of The Imperial governments Zoning can still be seen to this day. The divide between poor neighborhoods and Wealthy ones is as little as a wall in areas. The [[Central Business district of vurahi|Central Business district]] (CBD) has a homeless epidemic. The suburb of [[Vor handa]] was transformed into a massive public housing bloc, the suburb is infamous for being the Centre of the [[The Drug epidemic In Areoix Lie|drug epidemic]] within [[Areoix Lie]]. Vurahi has undergone significant changes in the years since [[3rd Empire of Areoix Lie|The Empire]]. IT has experienced economic growth and development in the post-Empire era. The HDI index steadily rose until 1729 shortly after [[Assassination of Orin Valorum|Valorum was assassinated]]. The [[RPAL|RPAL party]] became notorious for rampant corruption and state capture on all levels on goverment.

[[DAEL|The DAEL]], a liberal political party that came to power in Vurahi in 1737, has been credited with improving bureaucratic efficiency, public safety, and fostering economic development. The city has become a major economic hub in [[Areoix Lie]], attracting international investment and tourism in recent years. In 1738 the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Presidential palace]] was dismantled and transformed into the [[Imperial Museum of Areoix Lie|Imperial Museum]]

In 1748, [[President Dan Sarkozy]] launched the [[The City Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality|Grand Vurahi project]] to integrate Vurahi more closely with the towns in the surrounding region. After many modifications, the new area, named the [[the City Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality]] with a population of 19.8 million, was created on 1 1st 1750. In 1751, the City of Vurahi and the national government approved the plans for the [[Grand Vurahi Express|Grand Vurahi Express,]] totalling 890km (553.02 mi) of automated metro lines to connect Vurahi, the innermost three Municipalities around Vurahi, airports and [[high-speed rail (TGV)]] stations, at an estimated cost of 35 billion. The system is scheduled to be complete in 1770; however, the majority of it is already operational and is held in high regard by the public.

In 1st 1755, [[Fa-Baravon]] in the [[Terressin]] claimed attacks across the Vurahi region. [[The March against Terror ( Vurahi )|5.5 million people marched in Vurahi]] in a show of solidarity against terrorism and in support of freedom of speech. In November of the same year, terrorist attacks, claimed by IDEM, killed 260 people and injured more than 1350

Nowadays, Vurahi is led by [[Vera Namqic|Mayor Vera Namqic]]. The DAEL won 37 of the city's 52 seats in the last election.
